name: Minimal Nordic
description: A compact low-ornament compass card with a restrained teal wind spear.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. This fallback favors silhouette and cardinal readability; the solid gold heading needle clearly outweighs the thin teal wind spear.

orientationConventions.ring: Static north-up card. North is baked at 12 o'clock.
orientationConventions.headingPointer: The broad muted-gold tip points to 12 o'clock at heading 0. Its boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure player world bearing.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The thin teal spear tip points to 12 o'clock at wind bearing 0. Its pivot is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure wind-toward world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Optional static top accent for the north index. It does not replace the heading pointer.
